items.explanation: contact.html contains literal labels "Name:" and "Message:", and index.html contains "E-mail:", but contact.html's E-mail input has no label text at all, so "E-mail:" is missing from the contact form.
index.html's Earth table row has the notes cell "Our world" and the row's planet name "Earth", but no contiguous text "Earth is Our world" appears in the page.

risks.title: Contact form lacks an "E-mail:" label next to the email input
risks.explanation: contact.html shows an email input with no associated label element or text, while Name and Message inputs do have labels; the only "E-mail:" label text is in index.html.
risks.suggestion: Add a label with text "E-mail:" (for="mail") to the email input in contact.html and confirm the intended page for the three labels.

risks.title: index.html does not contain the phrase "Earth is Our world"
risks.explanation: The Earth row uses "Earth" as the row header and "Our world" as the Notes cell; no sentence joining them exists in the page source.
risks.suggestion: Decide with the buyer whether the notes cell "Our world" suffices or an explicit "Earth is Our world" string is required; if so, add it.
